title: Felix and the Garden
author: B. M. Dunmore
blurb: Marguerite Pemberton, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
